author: Zegita
body:
Hey guys it's Zegita here and most of you know me from Avicus and as you are wondering a lot of people asked me how do you make tnt cannons? So I made a short video here explaining the basics and the advanced techniques of making a proper quick TNT cannon!

I hope you guys enjoy the video and like it if you do enjoy and please if you haven't subscribed subscribe if you want tosee more :)

How to make a TNT Cannon https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=620p85fdCWw&feature=youtu.be

Sorry if this may be across as advertising I just want to help all you people on this wonderful server. Peace out!

"Zegita or Zeg"
